entries.label: Capital gains inclusion rate (2026)
entries.notes: Half of the gain is included in income; only that half is taxed at the marginal rate. The 2024 Budget proposed raising the rate to 66.67% on gains above $250,000 - CANCELLED March 21, 2025. Never present the 66.67% rate as live.

rejected.reason: Proposed in 2024 Budget; proposal cancelled March 21, 2025.

entries.label: Principal residence exemption
entries.notes: Cottages, rentals, second properties face the 50% inclusion rate.
entries.value: Capital gains on a principal residence are fully exempt; the sale must still be reported on the return
